$comment: TBD: Update $id, replace `develop` with the future release tag. This file is hand-maintained: `invoke generate-app-config-schema` infers properties from the development `PLUGINS_CONFIG`, so it drops every key that config does not set. Merge its output into this file rather than replacing it.

nornir_settings.description: Configuration parameters that Nornir itself consumes. See the Nornir documentation.

inventory.description: Dotted path to the Nornir inventory plugin class.

credentials.description: Dotted path to the credential provider class.

inventory_params.description: Extra parameters passed to the credential provider by the inventory.

runner.description: Nornir runner plugin and its options. The `threaded` plugin enables idle database connection cleanup.

use_config_context.description: Whether to pull Secret Access Type and/or Connection Options from config context.

connection_options.description: Nornir connection options applied globally to all connections, keyed by Nornir connection plugin name. The contents are passed to the plugin, so they are not constrained here.

allowed_location_types.description: Location types to group automatically. An empty list allows all types.

denied_location_types.description: Location types to exclude from automatic grouping.

username.description: Username for the CredentialsSettingsVars credential provider.

password.description: Password for the CredentialsSettingsVars credential provider.

secret.description: Secret (enable) password for the CredentialsSettingsVars credential provider.
